_meta.purpose: Roadmap #317 Phase 2 Part A staging artifact -- NOT yet wired into generate.py, the worker, or any page. Structured extraction (not new legal research) of the qualifying-criteria and grandfather-date facts already present in worker/src/mobility_rules.json's own notes/flux_note fields for the 25 'individual_criteria' mobility states. Produced 2026-08-11 via 5 parallel extraction passes (Read-only, no web fetches -- every fact traces back to the already dual-source-verified prose in mobility_rules.json). This is the 'one sourcing pass against the actual rule text' the roadmap item's own text called for before designing the exact new Add Staff/CSV import fields.
_meta.key_finding: 9 of 25 states (36%) have genuinely unresolved statute-vs-rule conflicts or incompletely-itemized pathways in the source data itself -- these are NOT extraction errors, they're real live conditions in the underlying law (a board rule not yet conformed to a new statute, or a board that hasn't adopted implementing criteria yet). Any UI/product design for this feature needs an honest 'we can't give a definitive answer for this state yet' path for these 9, matching this codebase's existing 'we withhold when sources disagree' pattern (mobility.ts's flux_summary/rule_in_flux machinery) -- NOT a binary checkbox that silently produces a false-definitive answer for a third of these states.
next_steps_not_yet_done: Design the exact 1-2 new Add Staff/CSV import fields (e.g. a 'met qualifying pathway at licensure' attestation, possibly a grandfather-date comparison against license issue date already on the roster row) -- a real product/UX decision, not made here.
New migration column(s) on subscribers/licenses for whatever field shape is chosen.
CSV import wiring for the new field(s), reusing the existing drParseCsv()/DR_CSV_KNOWN_COLUMNS pattern.

Wire worker/src/mobility.ts's evaluateMobility() to consume the new field(s) for individual_criteria states and produce a definitive verdict instead of the current generic handling -- with an explicit 'unresolved, ambiguous state' branch for the 9 ambiguous states above, not a forced yes/no.
Tests: at minimum one clear-state pass, one ambiguous-state pass, one grandfathered-CPA pass, per the mobility test suite's existing conventions.
